sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals 10% of max HP every 5 seconds for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: yourself. Applies hero for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies debuffs, status ailments, and Unison gauge reduction; nullifies buffs [Demerit]; reduces healing effects received by 70% [Demerit]).
-Applies Star Gene (increases max HP by 40%, increases DEF and MDEF by 40%, increases star elemental attack by 8, and increases star elemental defense by 100) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
